scope: Actual Android native voice transport and playback on an owned API 35 emulator; synthetic local WebRTC peer, no model or provider inference.

input.audio: 20-second local 440 Hz signal plus silent carrier
input.captionRequest: This exact passage should stay visible while the audio plays and after it finishes.

observations.screenOffAudioMixer: App-owned active mono speech PCM track, content type speech

fix: Accept streamless ontrack events by constructing a MediaStream from the supplied track before attaching the audio element, analyser and recorder.
limitations: Audio was a synthesized test signal rather than intelligible model-generated speech.
This checks actual PCM playback, captions and screen-off service continuity; it does not qualify provider pronunciation or live transcription quality.
No secure keyguard was configured on this emulator; private/redacted notification metadata was inspected, but a physical secure-lock-screen presentation was not exercised.
